The full-stack system effectively addresses core pain points of current AI smartphones, including high AI computing power consumption, insufficient local inference real-time performance, poor compatibility of upper intelligent applications, and low resource utilization of heterogeneous hardware, while delivering seamless, low-latency, high-security AI interaction experiences across core scenarios such as intelligent photography, personal voice assistants, real-time translation, and on-device privacy computing. As a systematic engineering that unifies underlying technical iteration and upper ecological co-construction, the full-stack AI smartphone solution provides a scalable, general-purpose technical framework for the large-scale popularization of next-generation intelligent mobile terminals, and offers valuable references for the industry to break through the performance bottlenecks of standalone hardware and build a differentiated competitive advantage centered on full-stack intelligent capabilities.
